description: Main window. File access is limited to the four top-level JSON files the frontend persists (queue, history, settings, subscriptions) plus their .tmp write-then-rename twins, and to files the user picks in a save dialog. Nothing recursive: torrent-session/, torrents/ and engine/ under app data belong to Rust. Deliberately no fs:default — its recursive app-dir scope is global and would merge into every fs command below. Guarded by a test in src-tauri/src/lib.rs.
